text:
Alex: :wave: handing off to Mira now. Primary is Mira, I’m secondary until 22:00 PT. Quick notes: customer-facing incidents  currently routed to regional pool A, there’s a small coverage gap for APAC after 21:30 PT. please confirm.

Oncall Bot: Reminder: scheduled handoff 1978912345 initiated by Alex. Handoff checklist attached.

Mira: got it. I see the APAC drift in the dashboard. Is that the autoscaler cooldown causing the gap?

Alex: yes, looks like a cooldown + one host in pool-a failed health checks and did not rejoin automatically. I raised a ticket to infra but ETA unknown.

Irene: pinging infra on the ticket — if the host doesn't rejoin within 10m we should trigger reserved burst in eu-west as fallback. That will add ~40ms p99 to APAC users but keeps requests flowing.

Mira: agreed. Can we add the fallback routing policy to the active policy now? Who owns that?

Jonathan: I can apply the policy. Quick reminder of escalation matrix: page primary immediately for Sev3+, if no ack in 5 min page secondary, if still no ack escalate to SRE lead and oncall manager. For Sev2, page primary and add a DM to secondary. For customer-impacting realtime degradation (SLA-affecting) we escalate to Eng-sre and product on duty.

Alex: adding the runbook pointer for routing fallback:

```
Runbook: Inference -> Routing -> Fallback to regional burst
1) Console -> Routing Policies -> select 'prod-primary'
2) Edit rule: add fallback region: eu-west-1 with weight 0.25
3) Save & monitor token latency and error rate
4) If errors persist >10m -> run pooled restart: infra oncall
```

Mira: applying the fallback now. Jonathan, please stand by to rollback if we see any regressions.

Oncall Bot: Action logged: Mira applied routing policy change at 1978912438. Audit ID: RB-2026-11.

Mira: update: policy applied. APAC 95th latency rose ~35ms immediately but error rate dropped from 4.2% -> 0.6%.

Irene: good. I'm still waiting on infra — they reported they have a team looking at the failed host, may need to reprovision. I'll post updates.

Alex: FYI on when to page who (copied from pager rules):
- Sev1 (outage/major customer impact): page primary + all oncall SREs, escalate to SRE lead in 3m if no ack. Pager string: "SEV1 - inference pod outage" + playbook link.
- Sev2 (degraded): page primary only, DM secondary. If no ack in 10m escalate to secondary via pager.
- Sev3 (minor/QA): Slack DM only unless it becomes customer impacting.

Jonathan: also add this for paging escalation steps: page escalation list -> [Primary oncall Pager, Secondary pager, SRE Lead pager, Engineering Manager]. Use phone pager if Slack unresponsive.

Mira: acknowledging here. I'll keep primary duty until 22:00 PT. If anything looks like a rollout regression (error spike correlated with model rollout), call a pause and page release-owner.

Alex: noted. For handoff notes: leaving these outstanding items: 1) infra ticket #INF-4729 for host reprovision 2) healthcheck thresholds were temporarily lowered in the last release (see PR #337) 3) telemetry alert that fired: inference-error-rate-prod > 2% for 5m.

Oncall Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-298. Linked to thread 1978912345. Severity: Sev2. Impact: degraded inference for APAC customers.

Irene: infra update: reprovision attempted, host failed boot twice, they will try a manual redeploy in 15m. If that fails, recommendation is to decommission and replace.

Mira: if they decommission, confirm capacity in dedicated pools to absorb traffic, otherwise we keep fallback routing.

Jonathan: quick checklist to escalate to manager/SRE lead if metrics cross thresholds:
1) Error rate > 3% sustained for 10m OR
2) P50 latency increase > 200ms with customer-reported errors OR
3) Failed request ratio > 1% for key customers (top 5).

Mira: setting a local alert for the above so we can auto-escalate. Also leaving runbook link for the oncoming team: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-fallback.

Alex: thanks. Two small policy clarifications for future handoffs: 1) If primary becomes unresponsive, secondary has authority to page SRE lead immediately after the second pager attempt (no extra approvals). 2) For cross-region fallbacks, ensure product is notified via #product-alerts channel and include expected latency delta.

Irene: noted. I'll add those to the oncall playbook PR.

Mira: final: I'm marking this handoff as warm. I'll DM Alex 15m before end of shift in case we need an extended secondary window. If anything escalates to Sev1, I'll page according to matrix and create an incident bridge.

Alex: :thumbsup: thanks team. leaving thread open for infra updates.

Oncall Bot: Handoff acknowledged. Mira is primary until 22:00 PT. Audit trail saved.

Irene: infra update @ 1978912967: manual redeploy succeeded, host rejoined pool-a, monitoring shows errors back at baseline. Infra will keep degraded host flagged for deeper investigation tomorrow.

Mira: great, thanks. I'll start removing the fallback in 2m and monitor.

Jonathan: closing checklist: remove fallback, confirm latencies, update incident notes. If all green, mark INC-2026-298 as mitigated and move to RCA queue.

Alex: confirmed. Thanks everyone.
